tournament.name: South America Magic Series - Final Regional Championship

decks.notes: The deck focuses on utilizing control elements to manage the board and disrupt opponent's strategies. Cards like Negate, Ossification, and Make Disappear help to counter opponent's spells and remove threats. The main win condition is through generating advantage with cards like The Eternal Wanderer and Leyline Binding, while also using powerful creatures like Atraxa, Grand Unifier and Contagious Vorrac to close out the game. The deck also includes a mix of lands to ensure smooth mana production and consistency in casting spells.

This Mono White Control deck focuses on board control through cards like Depopulate and Ossification. It also includes cards like The Restoration of Eiganjo and Elspeth Resplendent to provide healing and protection. The deck aims to disrupt opponent's strategies with cards like Lay Down Arms and Reckoner Bankbuster, while also establishing a strong board presence with creatures like The Wandering Emperor and Ambitious Farmhand. The deck also includes mana ramp cards like Wedding Announcement and Mirrex to ensure consistent resource generation.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly overpower opponents with an aggressive strategy. The deck includes a mix of powerful creatures such as Adeline, Resplendent Cathar and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse, along with disruptive creatures like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben. The spells in the deck, such as Go for the Throat and Wedding Announcement, provide removal and added versatility. The deck also includes a variety of lands to support the deck's color requirements and provide a stable mana base. Overall, the deck aims to establish a dominant board presence and quickly defeat opponents.

The main concept of this Selesnya Aggro deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of low-cost, high-power creatures and powerful combat tricks. The deck aims to establish a fast and aggressive board presence by playing efficient creatures like Annex Sentry and Bloated Contaminator, supported by combat enhancements like Tyvar's Stand and Destroy Evil. The deck also features cards like Venerated Rotpriest and Slaughter Singer to provide additional value and combat support. Overall, the deck focuses on applying early pressure and maintaining board presence to secure victory through relentless aggression.

The main focus of this Boros Control deck is to maintain board presence through cards that disrupt the opponent's strategy, such as Ossification and Depopulate, while also creating advantage with Wedding Announcement and Lay Down Arms. The deck also includes strong finishers like Elspeth Resplendent and The Wandering Emperor to close out the game. The balance of removal, card advantage, and threats allows the player to control the pace of the game and outvalue their opponent to secure victory.

This Mono White Control deck focuses on slowing down the opponent's strategy by utilizing creature removal and board control effects. It aims to establish dominance with powerful creatures like Steel Seraph and Elspeth Resplendent while protecting them with cards like Sanctuary Warden and Lay Down Arms. The deck also includes cards for card advantage and resource manipulation, such as The Restoration of Eiganjo and Roadside Reliquary. By controlling the board and outlasting the opponent, this deck sets itself up for victory through attrition and careful planning.

The main concept of this Rakdos Control deck is to disrupt and control the opponent's game plan through a combination of removal spells, hand disruption, and powerful creatures. The deck aims to maintain board control and slow down the opponent's strategy while gradually building up its own board presence. By utilizing a mix of removal, discard, and powerful threats like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Bloodtithe Harvester, the deck seeks to outvalue and outlast the opponent in a long game. The mana base is strategically crafted to support the deck's color requirements for maximum efficiency.

This aggro Selesnya deck focuses on flooding the board with low cost creatures and using effects like Skrelv's Hive and Charge of the Mites to buff them up quickly. Venerated Rotpriest provides additional damage and life gain, while cards like Annex Sentry and Tyvar's Stand help protect your creatures. The deck also includes some removal options like Slaughter Singer and Crawling Chorus to control the board. Boseiju, Who Endures can help ensure your spells go off, while Loran's Escape and Viral Spawning provide additional ways to overwhelm your opponent.

This deck focuses on aggressive plays using a mix of creatures and spells to apply pressure on the opponent. It includes a variety of powerful creatures like Skrelv, Thalia, and Adeline to quickly build up a board presence. The inclusion of disruptive cards like Dennick and The Raven Man helps control the battlefield. The deck also features a strong mana base with a mix of dual lands to ensure consistent casting of spells. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and efficient aggro strategy.

This deck focuses on disruption and removal, using cards like Abrade, Go for the Throat, and Cut Down to control the opponent's board. It also includes cards like Graveyard Trespasser and Corpse Appraiser to manage graveyard interactions. The deck aims to outvalue the opponent by getting ahead in resources and controlling the flow of the game. Key cards like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker provide powerful late-game threats. Overall, the deck seeks to outlast opponents through removal, disruption, and powerful creatures.

This Grixis Aggro deck focuses on using a combination of removal spells and aggressive creatures to overwhelm the opponent. The deck includes powerful creatures like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Phyrexian Fleshgorger, backed up by spells like Infernal Grasp and Go for the Throat to control the board. Liliana of the Veil provides additional disruption, while Fable of the Mirror-Breaker can generate card advantage. The deck aims to curve out efficiently and apply pressure on the opponent, utilizing a mix of creatures and spells to secure victory.

The deck focuses on using a combination of removal spells, powerful creatures, and graveyard manipulation to control the game and outvalue the opponent. Cards like Reckoner Bankbuster and Unleash the Inferno provide strong win conditions, while cards like Cut Down and Go for the Throat keep the opponent's board in check. Graveyard Trespasser and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker help to disrupt the opponent's game plan, while Glissa Sunslayer and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse provide additional threats and recursion. The lands in the deck are tuned to provide the necessary colors and mana fixing for the deck's strategy.

The main focus of this deck is to control the opponent's resources and slowly grind them down while building up your own board presence. The deck includes various cards to remove threats, protect your own creatures, and generate card advantage. With a mix of removal spells, creatures with strong abilities, and land destruction, the goal is to outvalue the opponent and control the game until you can secure victory. The deck's mono white color means it is focused on efficient and powerful white cards to achieve its objectives.

The main focus of this deck is to establish control over the game by utilizing a variety of removal spells and cards that disrupt the opponent's strategies. The deck is primarily centered around utilizing mono white cards to maintain a defensive position while gradually building up a board presence. Cards like Wedding Announcement and Lay Down Arms provide utility and disruption, while cards like Reckoner Bankbuster and The Wandering Emperor help to control the board and dictate the pace of the game. The deck also includes cards like Ossification and The Restoration of Eiganjo to deal with threats efficiently.

This deck focuses on aggressive gameplay with a mix of powerful creatures and burn spells to deal damage quickly to the opponent. The key strategy is to apply pressure early in the game with creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Bloodthirsty Adversary, while using removal spells like Lightning Strike and Go for the Throat to control the board. Ob Nixilis, the Adversary provides additional card advantage, while cards like Feldon, Ronom Excavator offer versatility in recurring creatures. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of fast creatures and direct damage spells.

This deck focuses on using a combination of creatures and spells to bring powerful creatures back from the graveyard, allowing for explosive plays and overwhelming the opponent. By utilizing cards like The Cruelty of Gix and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker to set up the graveyard, followed by reanimating spells like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Atraxa, Grand Unifier, this deck can quickly turn the tide of the game in your favor. With a mix of removal spells and powerful creatures, this deck aims to dominate the battlefield and secure victory through its powerful combos.
